$schema_note: Curated knowledge. Each entry is compiled into the knowledge base ONLY when status === 'approved'. Draft entries are excluded by scripts/build-knowledge.js and the agent will therefore deflect those questions to a call rather than guess. This is deliberate: Hard Rule 2 forbids invented capabilities, so an unfilled entry must produce silence, not a plausible sentence.
$fill_instructions: For each entry: paste the factual, already-published description of the item into `content`, then set status to 'approved'. Keep it to plain prose the agent can quote or paraphrase. Do not write aspirational or roadmap language — only what is true and shippable today. Re-run `npm run build:knowledge` after editing.

entries.prompt: One paragraph: what Vikat is, the category it sits in, and who it is for.
What VCommand is, the problem it solves, and its primary capabilities as currently shipped.
What VShield is, the problem it solves, and its primary capabilities as currently shipped.
What VInsight is, the problem it solves, and its primary capabilities as currently shipped.
What VSentinel is, the problem it solves, and its primary capabilities as currently shipped.
What Vikat does for MCP server security, which products cover it, and the buyer problem it addresses.
What Vikat does for agent security, which products cover it, and the buyer problem it addresses.
What Vikat does for application and cloud security, which products cover it, and the buyer problem it addresses.
What Vikat does for AI governance, which products cover it, and the buyer problem it addresses.
How Vikat is deployed today (e.g. SaaS, self-hosted, hybrid, in-VPC) and what each implies for the customer. Only list models that are actually available.
How a prospect starts: evaluation, pilot/POC, production rollout. Typical shape and duration of each, without committing to pricing.
Vikat's posture on technology partners, resellers, MSSPs and integrations. Name only partners that are publicly announced.
Systems Vikat integrates with today (cloud providers, SIEM/SOAR, identity, CI/CD). List only shipped integrations.
Static. Safe to keep approved — contains no product claims.
entries.content: Prospects can book time with the Vikat team using the booking link the assistant provides via the request_meeting tool, or reach the team by email. The assistant can pass along a name, email, company, role and a short description of the use case so the team arrives at the call already briefed.

entries.section: What this assistant can and cannot do
entries.prompt: Static. Safe to keep approved — describes the assistant, not the product.
entries.content: This assistant answers questions about Vikat's products and solution areas from Vikat's published material, and can arrange a conversation with the team. It does not quote prices, discuss company financials, name customers, commit to roadmap dates, or complete security questionnaires — those go to the Vikat team directly. Conversations are logged and reviewed by Vikat.
